build_steps.description: Install system packages required for building native extensions
build_steps.command: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq cmake libssl-dev pkg-config python3.11-venv patch python3-dev git curl

build_steps.description: Copy setup_runtime.sh and repo_setup.sh from build context
Run repo_setup.sh to materialize /workspace from git repository
Run setup_runtime.sh to create Python venv and install dependencies

notes: Dockerfile.final is the single authoritative packaging spec. The image installs system packages, materializes /workspace via repo_setup.sh, and sets up Python venv via setup_runtime.sh. Verifier assets (eval.sh, test.patch) are runtime-mounted at /opt/benchmark/, not baked into the image. The RL agent runs: cd /workspace && source /opt/benchmark/venv/bin/activate && /opt/benchmark/eval.sh
